versions.changelog: Add standard invocation example (标准调用示例); bump to v1.1.2

**Expanded executable agent contract, figure translation workflow, and Windows pipeline integration.**

- Added an executable agent contract requiring direct end-to-end translation and document assembly without external delegation.
- Mandated full use of Image 2/image-edit for figure translation; clarified fallback order and hard blockers.
- Integrated a detailed Windows pipeline, including new scripts for DOCX build, visual verification, and translation caching.
- Strengthened delivery policy: only two verified DOCX files accepted, rigorous QA, no user configuration prompts.
- Added supporting and example files for figure localization, translation caching, and batch processing.
- Removed obsolete orchestration scripts and replaced old skill-card documentation with detailed, enforceable contracts.
v1.1.0：新增可恢复的全文翻译流水线；强制使用 Image2 对论文图片进行图内中文覆盖，并通过哈希清单与视觉验收确认；新增 Word/WPS COM 渲染和逐页检查；修复 WPS 内引文跳转；新增最终交付验证器；删除时间限制。

No user-facing changes in this version.  
- Version bump with no file or documentation changes detected.  
- Functionality, usage, and workflow remain unchanged.
v1.0.1：收到可读取论文后直接生成并交付两份 DOCX，不再询问默认设置；删除全部交付时间限制；要求所有需替换英文图内文字的栅格图必须经 Image 2 原图编辑并视觉验收。

translate-academic-papers 1.0.0

- Initial release supporting full translation of English academic papers into polished Simplified Chinese, preserving structure, evidence, equations, tables, and citation numbering.
- Produces two DOCX files by default: a complete Chinese edition and a paragraph-aligned bilingual English-Chinese edition.
- Translates all semantic text inside figures and tables, with strict visual quality checks and hard failure on untranslated figure elements.
- Ensures accuracy in terminology, paragraph alignment, and document navigation, referencing detailed internal standards.
- Implements a quality-first policy: prioritizes complete, verified translations over fixed time targets, with validation-driven retries for failed pipeline segments.
- Adds clickable citation-to-reference links in the output and preserves the original English reference list.
